Justification: role already imports permission (role_policy_sync.go and role tests), there is no package cycle (`go list -deps ./modules/system/iam/permission` contains 0 role packages), and a single authoritative model eliminates the drift surface structurally. No new gate script was added, so no gate-approval is needed.

The role package diff also contains the sibling tenant-scope wave (Scoper conversion). The model-specific delta is the deleted struct plus rewrites of its references; the two waves share the same role_service.go.

Schema-vs-model deltas were recorded, not fixed: migrations name the composite index idx_role_data_scope_tenant_role (non-unique) while both models declare uniqueIndex:uk_role_data_scope_tenant_role; the legacy scope_defs column and created_at/updated_at are unmapped by any model. These are migration-governance items (migrations are doNotTouch here), not model-vs-model drift.

The pre-existing delete path still writes the legacy permission_role_data_scope_policy table in addition to system_role_data_scope; that behaviour is unchanged, and `grep role_data_scope_policy` matches only this legacy table name, a comment and the dashboard table whitelist — not the deleted Go type.
